content: Implement repository layer for PATCH /api/users/:id with update queries and constraints
activeForm: Implementing repository layer for PATCH /api/users/:id with update queries and constraints
description: Implement user.repository.ts with updateUser method that handles partial profile updates. Implements database-level update queries with proper constraints, transaction handling, and auto-updating updated_at timestamp. Validates unique constraints on username, handles INTEGER id parameter, and ensures ENUM status field validation. Write 20 MVP-tier tests (unit tests for update query generation, integration tests for database operations and transactions). This subtask provides the data access layer that will be used by the controller in T2.2.

checkpoints.name: Update Query Implementation Complete
checkpoints.requirement: Repository updateUser method created with proper SQL UPDATE query generation and parameter binding

checkpoints.name: Transaction and Constraint Tests Passing
checkpoints.requirement: First 12 tests passing (update queries, unique constraints, transaction rollback verified)

phases.name: Repository Method Implementation
actions: Implement: updateUser(id: number, updates: Partial<User>): Promise<User | null>
Build: SQL UPDATE query with dynamic field updates (only update provided fields)
Implement: Auto-updating updated_at timestamp (database-level trigger or manual)
Return: Updated user object or null if user not found
phases.gate: Update query must support partial updates (only provided fields) before proceeding

phases.name: Constraint and Transaction Handling
actions: Implement: Unique constraint validation for username field
Implement: Transaction support for atomic updates
Handle: Constraint violation errors (return user-friendly messages)
Implement: Optimistic locking check (prevent concurrent update conflicts)
Exclude: id, created_at from updates (immutable fields)

phases.name: MVP Test Suite (20 tests)
actions: Write: 8 unit tests for update query generation and parameter binding
Write: 12 integration tests for database operations, constraints, and transactions
Verify: All 20 tests passing with 90%+ coverage of repository layer
Verify: Unique constraint violations properly caught and handled
